interaction: GET tag pages under 12-way crawler burst
title: Deep tag-page prerenders returned 503 under sustained crawler concurrency (pg pool acquire timeouts surfaced as bounded dependency failures)
evidence: seo-snapshot 2026-08-19T15-02 run: 45 failures, 27x 503 on /tag/* pages
app log: 'timeout exceeded when trying to connect' from pool acquire during 12-way bursts (pool max=8, acquire timeout 3000ms)
post-fix gate 2026-08-19T15-22-38: 0 failures, 100.00% schema pass (2324/2324); warm burst harness 24/24 OK
cold-cache reruns 2026-08-19T15-38-17 (3x503) and 15-42-11 (5x503) exposed warm-cache flattery of the ladder-only fix
real-lock resilience after bounded queue hardening: 80/80 saturated SSR routes returned 503, fastest overflow rejection 29ms, recovery 200 in 26ms, no late write
suggested_fix: Retry saturation-class failures (SQLSTATE 53300, pool acquire timeout, publicCache rebuild-capacity) inside og-middleware with short backoff before emitting the bounded 503; keep outage classes (lock/statement timeout) fail-fast so resilience budgets hold.
resolution: The retry ladder remains limited to downstream transient pool/public-cache saturation. Uncached route resolution is capped at 5 active requests with at most 32 abort-aware waiters; local overflow bypasses retries and returns the bounded 503 immediately. Cold-cache confirmation 2026-08-19T16-44-57: 0 fetch failures, 100.00% schema (2324/2324), parity 20/20. Real-lock resilience: 80/80 SSR 503, 29ms fastest overflow response, recovery 200 in 26ms, no late write.
